explication: Joern is a multi-language static-analysis workbench. A user invokes the console or a frontend on source, bytecode, or binaries; a language generator builds a code property graph (CPG), which workspace management persists and loads. Query bundles are discovered and executed against the graph, with the data-flow engine resolving paths and returning vulnerability-analysis results. The tree and sampled files support the main orchestration and analysis layers; several frontend and scanner internals are represented at their enclosing directories.
